name: EMIT Vol. 1: Toki no Maigo
source:
Emit is an adventure game that is the first entry of Shibusawa Kou's "English Dream" series. The purpose behind the projects was to teach Japanese people the English language with the help of a thrilling narrative.

On October 5, 1994, a seventeen year old high school student named Yuri meets a polite yet mysterious elderly gentleman at the crosswalk. Although puzzled by his questions, she answers them honestly to the best of her ability. As Yuri walks across the street, she hears the man mutter the word "Emit" to her. Yuri thinks nothing of the conversation until an oddly familiar yet attractive young man approaches her a month later on the street. 

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Emit]Koei Wiki[/url]]

Emit is a fully voice and text driven digital novel with the added bonus of being fully bilingual. By this I mean you can choose from any combination of Japanese / English text and audio.

[From [url=http://www.segagagadomain.com/saturn8/emit-vol1.htm]SegaGagaDomain[/url]]
translation:
《Emit》是一款冒險遊戲，也是澀澤光「英語之夢」系列的第一作。該系列旨在通過扣人心絃的敘事幫助日本人學習英語。

1994年10月5日，17歲的高中生百合在十字路口遇見一位禮貌卻神秘的老人。儘管對他的問題感到困惑，她仍盡己所能如實作答。百合過馬路時，聽見老人喃喃對她說出「Emit」。她沒有把這場談話放在心上，直到一個月後，一名陌生又莫名熟悉的俊美青年在街上接近她。

[摘自[url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Emit]光榮維基[/url]]

《Emit》是一部全語音、以文字推進的電子小說，完整支援雙語。也就是說，玩家可自由組合日、英文文字和語音。

[摘自[url=http://www.segagagadomain.com/saturn8/emit-vol1.htm]SegaGagaDomain[/url]]
